info.description: TOUCHE COMMERCE trade management API. Stage 1A exposes identity (server-side sessions), multi-company membership and tenant isolation on top of the Stage 0 foundation.
info.title: TOUCHE COMMERCE API

get.summary: Service descriptor
Recent requests with usage and tool counts
The signed-in user's conversations in the active company

post.summary: Start a conversation

get.summary: One conversation with its messages and proposals

post.description: Accepted with 202; the model runs in the background. Poll the returned run. Refused with 503 when the AI Office is disabled, 413 for an oversized message, 429 for the per-user rate limit, the daily budget or too many concurrent runs.
post.summary: Ask the Trade Director

get.summary: Drafts and task proposals awaiting a human decision
One proposal

patch.description: Requires If-Match. Only wording can change; the target and cited evidence stay as produced. An edited proposal is marked EDITED_BY_USER.
patch.summary: Edit the wording of a pending proposal

post.description: Requires If-Match and ``trade.write``. Permissions, state, version and the target record are re-validated here. Supported actions: DRAFT_REVIEW, OPERATOR_TASK. Proposals with unverified figures need ``acknowledge_warnings``.
post.summary: Approve a proposal (a human decision; nothing is sent or posted)
Reject a proposal

get.summary: Progress and result of one request

post.summary: Cancel a running request

get.description: Never returns a credential or the provider URL. ``mode`` says whether answers come from the offline mock, a real provider or nothing (disabled).
get.summary: AI provider status, limits and today's usage
Suggested starting questions
The tool registry, approval classes and blocked actions

post.description: Verifies the credentials with Argon2id, applies the login rate limit and creates a server-side session. The opaque session token is delivered in an HttpOnly cookie; the body never contains the token or the password hash. All failures return the same 401 message so account existence is not revealed. The active company is auto-selected only when the user has exactly one active membership.
post.summary: Sign in and open a server-side session

post.description: Revokes the session row immediately (the cookie alone would be useless afterwards) and clears the cookie. Requires the CSRF header.
post.summary: Revoke the current session

get.description: Re-validates the session and the active membership on every call and returns the CSRF token the client must send on state-changing requests.
get.summary: Current user, active company and memberships

get.description:
Read existing company-scoped AI drafts; no side effects or external calls.

These rows are company-visible by the Stage 6 contract. A human approval
means 'reviewed', never 'delivered'. Return no address or contact details.
get.summary: List Communication Drafts

post.description:
Validate operator-entered recipient and draft state without sending.

No recipient is persisted, returned, logged or dispatched. A successful
preflight is deliberately impossible until a separately approved outbound
transport, dedicated sender role and independent human send approval exist.
post.summary: Communication Preflight

get.description:
Verified API shape for future provider setup; zero credentials or transport.

This is deliberately a configuration checklist, not an OAuth flow. No
deployment can silently derive a connected state from environment values.
get.summary: Provider Requirements

get.description: Report actual capabilities, never infer a configured provider.
get.summary: Communications Status

get.description: Administrator-only, tenant-scoped, bounded, address-free ledger view.
get.summary: List Suppressions

post.description:
Record a permanent safety block, never an opt-in or delivery permission.

An idempotency key is mandatory, and the audit row commits atomically with
the suppression. Duplicate blocks do not generate additional audit events.
post.summary: Create Suppression

get.description: Returns only companies with an active membership for the caller, together with the role and permissions held in each. The list is derived from the database on every request, so a revoked membership disappears immediately.
get.summary: Companies the signed-in user may access

get.description: Cursor-paginated, newest first. Filters are bound to the cursor: reusing a cursor with a different filter set is rejected with 422 instead of returning a misleading page.
get.summary: List counterparties

post.summary: Create a counterparty

get.summary: Read one counterparty

patch.description: Requires If-Match with the ETag from the last read. A stale version returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT including the current ETag; a missing header returns 428 PRECONDITION_REQUIRED. Unknown fields (for example status) are rejected.

200.description: Updated; the new ETag is returned.

get.description: Deal counts by status, open pipeline per currency, catalogue/CRM totals and the most recent deals and audit activity. All values come from the database in one transaction; nothing is inferred in the browser.
get.summary: Trade dashboard for the active company

get.description: Cursor-paginated, newest first. Every row carries its total value computed from the deal lines, so a table never has to sum client-side.
get.summary: List deals

post.description: Creates the deal, every line, the initial DRAFT history entry and the audit record in one transaction. A deal cannot reference a counterparty or product belonging to another company (composite foreign keys plus RLS).
post.summary: Create a deal with its lines

get.summary: Read one deal with lines, history and allowed transitions

patch.description: Header fields only: title, counterparty, currency, expected close date and notes. Sending status is rejected with 422 because status changes belong to the transition endpoint. Closed deals cannot be edited. Lines are immutable.

200.description: Updated; the new ETag is returned.

409.description: Closed deal, version or key conflict.

get.summary: List recorded customer acceptances for a deal

post.description: Records the customer's acceptance with its channel, timestamp and evidence reference. Internal approval alone is never treated as acceptance.
post.summary: Record documented customer acceptance of the approved quote revision

post.description: Atomic: the deal is locked, the approved quote revision and the customer acceptance evidence are verified, then the order, its immutable lines, the WON transition and the audit rows are written in one transaction. Requires an Idempotency-Key; a retry with the same key returns the original order.

409.description: Acceptance missing, quote not approved, or the deal is already WON.

post.summary: Convert an accepted quote into a sales order and win the deal

post.description: Requires Idempotency-Key. The optional If-Match header adds optimistic concurrency on top of row locking. The deal update, the deal_transition history row and the audit row commit in one transaction.

200.description: Transition accepted; the new ETag is returned.

409.description: INVALID_TRANSITION, TRANSITION_DISABLED, ALREADY_WON, VERSION_CONFLICT, IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT or IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS.

post.summary: Move a deal through the state machine

get.description: Newest first. Archived versions are returned only when explicitly requested; the configured upload ceiling is included so the UI can validate a file before sending it.
get.summary: List trade documents for the active company

post.description: Multipart upload. The server generates the storage key, recomputes the SHA-256 while writing, rejects unsupported content types and enforces the size ceiling during the stream. A new upload for the same entity and document type becomes the next version and archives the previous one.
post.summary: Upload a document version to private storage

get.summary: Read document metadata

post.summary: Archive a document version (controlled, never a silent delete)

get.description: Authorised against the active company *and* the linked business entity. The stored digest is verified before any byte is returned; a corrupted file raises 409 rather than serving unverified content.
get.summary: Download an authorised document
Every stored version of the same document

post.summary: Mark a document VERIFIED or REJECTED

get.description: Account-level debit, credit and balance for an explicit date range and currency. Amounts and Finance's debit-minus-credit sign are preserved.
get.summary: Finance account balances for the mapped company

get.description: FIFO aging with Finance's documented buckets and open fis_id source items. Counterparty names are free text and are not treated as stable master keys.
get.summary: Finance receivable or payable FIFO aging

get.description: Returns only the mapped Finance company's capabilities. The Finance key's other authorized company ids are deliberately not exposed.
get.summary: Verified Finance capabilities for the mapped company
List deterministic reconciliation discrepancies
Read one discrepancy inside the active company

post.description: Requires finance.reconcile. Resolution changes the discrepancy record only; it never changes a Finance ledger, invoice or payment.
post.summary: Resolve a discrepancy with reviewer notes

get.summary: List explicit evidence links for a run

post.description: Only transaction-level Finance aging ids are linkable. The amount is taken from the Finance snapshot, never from the request. A duplicate claim of the same source id in one run is rejected.
post.summary: Explicitly link one Commerce source to one Finance source id

get.description: Returns only orders with a complete estimate and complete documented basis. Quoted costs and incomplete cases are not presented as variance.
get.summary: Estimated versus documented cost variance
Financial evidence and reconciliation coverage

get.description: Reuses Stage 5D discrepancies and adds the affected order, currency, source reference, reviewer and last update. Resolution remains the existing finance.reconcile action.
get.summary: Enriched financial exception queue

get.description: Respects the same company scope and filters as the dashboard. Every row carries its currency, completeness and calculation version. The file is explicitly not a statutory statement and is protected against formula injection.
get.summary: Export operational financial analysis as CSV

get.description: Stable descending order-date pagination. Every amount is in the order currency; incomplete cost coverage remains explicit.
get.summary: Filtered order profitability list

get.description: Drill-down over the original accepted sales quote, pricing scenario, purchase orders, shipment costs, FX snapshots and Stage 5D evidence.
get.summary: Order profitability, evidence and reconciliation timeline

get.description: Real Commerce commitments, estimates and documented costs grouped by currency. No mixed-currency total, no Finance balance attribution and no statutory statement is produced.
get.summary: Operational financial intelligence summary

get.description: Shows accepted order value, purchase commitments, estimated landed cost, recorded operational costs and supported margins. Unavailable accounting facts stay labelled unavailable.
get.summary: Order finance view with separated commercial facts and evidence gaps

get.description: Lists tenant-scoped runs only. There is no cross-currency total: status counts are counts, and each run keeps its own currency.
get.summary: List evidence reconciliation runs for the active company

post.description: Reads Finance's supported summary and aging endpoints, records stable source ids and deterministic discrepancies. It never posts a journal, invoice or payment and never attributes a company-wide balance to an order.

409.description: Mapping or currency is not usable.

post.summary: Create an evidence reconciliation snapshot for one sales order

get.summary: Read one reconciliation run with evidence, discrepancies and reviews

post.description: Requires the distinct finance.reconcile permission. The run creator cannot review their own run. CONFIRM is the only path to VERIFIED and requires linked sales-order evidence, MATCHED_EVIDENCE and no open blocking discrepancies.

409.description: Not verifiable in the current state.

post.summary: Record an authorised financial review decision

get.description: Resolves the active Commerce company's explicit Finance mapping, verifies it against Finance capabilities and the authorized company list, and reports NOT_CONFIGURED / CONNECTED / DEGRADED / UNAVAILABLE / AUTH_ERROR. No credentials are returned.
get.summary: Read-only Finance integration status for the active company

get.description: Balances come from Finance's existing engine. A multi-currency company requires an explicit currency; amounts are never converted or aggregated.
get.summary: Finance ledger summary for the mapped company and one currency

get.description: Cursor-paginated, newest recording first. Filter by the currency pair. No endpoint returns a 'current' rate: pricing always refers to a stored snapshot so a landed cost stays reproducible.
get.summary: List recorded FX snapshots

post.description: Stores one sourced observation. The pair and effective time are unique per company, so recording the same observation twice is a 409 instead of a duplicate rate that could be picked arbitrarily.
post.summary: Record an FX snapshot

get.summary: Read one FX snapshot

get.description: Returns 200 as soon as the API process can serve HTTP. It deliberately performs no database, cache or network I/O so a dependency outage cannot cause the orchestrator to kill a healthy process.
get.summary: Liveness probe

get.description: Verifies that required dependencies are usable. Currently checks the PostgreSQL connection using the runtime role. Returns 503 with the standard error envelope when a dependency is unavailable.
get.summary: Readiness probe
Recent imports of the active company

post.description: Needs the SHA-256 of the previewed file. Invalid rows block the import; existing records are never updated and need skip_existing. The same file is recorded once: a repeat returns the recorded result with replayed=true and writes nothing.

400.description: Invalid rows or an unsafe file.

409.description: Changed file, existing records or nothing new.

post.summary: Create the new rows atomically (idempotent by file hash)
Read the file's headings and show how they map

post.description: Writes nothing. Rows are NEW, EXISTS (will be skipped, never changed) or INVALID.
post.summary: Dry run: validate every row and compare it with the company's records

get.summary: E-YAY read-only source market context (never executes orders)

get.description: Probes the locally configured Finance `GET /api/health` endpoint and reports whether Commerce can reach it. It never calls a business endpoint, never sends Finance a session or identity header, and never creates an invoice, payment or ledger entry.
get.summary: Read-only TOUCHE FINANCE link status

get.description: Counts and currency totals for orders, procurement, shipments and documents. 'Delayed' means a documented ETA that has passed on a live shipment; 'missing evidence' means a delivered shipment with no active delivery-confirmation document. No synthetic values.
get.summary: Operational counters derived from real rows

get.description: Cursor-paginated, newest first. The summary carries landed total, sales total and gross margin so a comparison table needs no extra call.
get.summary: List pricing scenarios

post.description: Converts the quote into the target currency using an explicit FX snapshot, allocates every cost component (ORDER pro-rata by purchase value, LINE to its product) and derives selling prices from exactly one of margin or markup. The inputs and the rounded results are stored together.

400.description: Missing FX snapshot, unpriced line or invalid component.

post.summary: Price a supplier quote (landed cost + selling price)

get.summary: Read one scenario with inputs, results and components

put.description: Replaces the cost components and reruns the engine for the same supplier quote. A scenario is bound to its quote: repointing it is a 400, not a silent rewrite of history.

200.description: Recalculated; the new ETag is returned.

put.summary: Recalculate a scenario with new inputs (If-Match required)

get.description: Cursor-paginated catalogue, newest first; search matches SKU and name.
get.summary: List products

post.summary: Create a product

get.summary: Read one product

200.description: Updated; the new ETag is returned.

get.summary: List supplier purchase orders

post.description: Refused for brokerage orders where TOUCHE is not the buyer. The order starts as DRAFT: nothing is sent to the supplier by this system.
post.summary: Create a draft supplier purchase order for a sales order

get.summary: Read a purchase order with its history and evidence

post.description: APPROVED needs finance.approve and a different person from the creator. RECORDED_SENT needs a channel, a timestamp and an external reference. SUPPLIER_CONFIRMED needs the supplier's confirmation reference.
post.summary: Approve, record dispatch or confirm a purchase order

get.description: Cursor-paginated, newest first. Each row carries its line and quote counts so a comparison table never has to fan out per row.
get.summary: List supplier RFQs

post.description: Every supplier receives its own RFQ with the same lines, created in one transaction. A buyer counterparty is rejected: an RFQ is addressed to a supplier. References are generated per RFQ.
post.summary: Create one RFQ per supplier

get.summary: Read one RFQ with lines, quotes and prepared revisions

patch.description: Draft and prepared RFQs are editable. Editing a prepared RFQ returns it to DRAFT and opens the next revision, so the prepared snapshot stays intact. Status is not writable here: use the transitions endpoint.

200.description: Updated; the new ETag is returned.

post.description: The quote inherits its supplier, deal and line descriptions from the RFQ. Only a SENT (or re-quoted RESPONDED) RFQ accepts a quote, and only one received quote may be active at a time: later prices are revisions.

400.description: Unknown product, invalid Incoterm or missing key.

409.description: RFQ not sent, or a quote is already active.

post.summary: Record a supplier's quote against a sent RFQ

get.description: Prepared snapshots are append-only; this returns the stored JSON as written.
get.summary: Read a prepared RFQ snapshot

post.description: Requires Idempotency-Key. PREPARED writes an immutable revision snapshot; SENT requires channel and evidence; CANCELLED requires a reason.

200.description: Transition accepted; the new ETag is returned.

post.summary: Move an RFQ through its lifecycle

get.description: Cursor-paginated, newest first. A viewer sees only this company's orders; RLS enforces the boundary even if a filter were wrong.
get.summary: List sales orders
Read a sales order with its frozen items and history

post.description: The accepted commercial snapshot is never rewritten. The amendment records exactly what changed, and a quantity cannot drop below what shipments already allocate.
post.summary: Amend an order with a recorded reason

get.description: Generated from the accepted order snapshot. Every payload is labelled DRAFT and carries an explicit notice that it is not a legally issued invoice, customs declaration, certificate or carrier document.
get.summary: DRAFT commercial-invoice or packing-list preview

get.description: Derived from shipment allocations and delivered shipments only. A partial delivery never marks the order fulfilled.
get.summary: Delivered versus ordered quantity per line

post.description: FULFILLED is rejected here: it is derived from delivered shipment quantities. CANCELLED requires a reason and preserves the commercial history.
post.summary: Move a sales order through its administrative states

get.description: Cursor-paginated, newest first. Each row includes the scenario status so a reviewer can see whether the underlying inputs were verified.
get.summary: List sales quotes

post.description: Prices are copied from the scenario's stored results, so the quote matches the calculation that was reviewed. A supplier counterparty cannot be a customer. The new quote starts in DRAFT.
post.summary: Draft a sales quote from a pricing scenario

get.summary: Read one sales quote with lines, revisions and allowed actions

post.description: Requires the ``finance.approve`` permission (traders and admins never hold it) and refuses the submitter, so approval is always a second pair of eyes.

200.description: Approved; the new ETag is returned.

post.summary: Approve a submitted quote (finance.approve)

post.description: A rejection explains itself: the reason is stored and audited.

200.description: Rejected; the new ETag is returned.

post.summary: Reject a submitted quote (finance.approve)

post.description: The new revision starts in DRAFT, carries the next revision number and supersedes the previous row. Prices are re-read from the pricing scenario.
post.summary: Open a new revision of an approved, rejected or withdrawn quote

get.summary: Read a stored sales quote revision snapshot

post.description: Only a scenario with VERIFIED_INPUTS may be submitted: an estimate can be drafted and discussed, never approved as if it were verified.

200.description: Submitted; the new ETag is returned.

409.description: Invalid transition, unverified scenario or version conflict.

post.summary: Submit a draft for approval (If-Match + Idempotency-Key required)

post.description: Withdrawal is a dead end: an approved quote cannot be withdrawn, it is superseded by a new revision instead, so the approval trail stays intact.

200.description: Withdrawn; the new ETag is returned.

post.summary: Withdraw a draft or submitted quote (If-Match required)

post.description: Requires a CSRF header and an active membership for the requested company. The company id supplied by the client is only used as a lookup key: an unauthorised id returns 403 and writes an ACCESS_DENIED audit record. On success the session token and CSRF token are rotated and the absolute expiry is preserved.

403.description: No membership, CSRF or origin rejected.

post.summary: Select the active company and rotate the session token

get.description: Delayed means a documented ETA that has passed while the shipment is not delivered or cancelled. No live carrier feed exists.
get.summary: List shipments

post.description: Quantities are validated against what is still outstanding per order line, and the unit must match the order line exactly.
post.summary: Plan a shipment (partial quantities allowed)

get.summary: Read a shipment with its timeline, references and costs

post.description: ESTIMATED, QUOTED, INCURRED and DOCUMENTED are separate stages; recording a cost never rewrites the Stage 3 pricing assumptions.
post.summary: Record a logistics cost with its certainty stage

post.description: Only IN_TRANSIT and DELAY_RECORDED milestones can be appended here; status changes go through the transition endpoint.
post.summary: Record an in-transit milestone or a documented delay

post.description: The provenance must be MANUAL or DOCUMENT_EVIDENCE: no external carrier verification exists in this stage.
post.summary: Record a booking, container or transport reference

post.description: DISPATCHED requires an actual dispatch timestamp and a carrier reference. ARRIVED requires the actual arrival timestamp (an ETA is not an arrival). DELIVERED requires a delivery evidence reference.
post.summary: Move a shipment through its timeline with evidence

get.description: Cursor-paginated by receipt time, newest first. Superseded revisions stay visible with their ``superseded_by_quote_id`` set, so a price history is never lost.
get.summary: List supplier quotes
Read one supplier quote with lines and revisions

post.description: Creates a new quote row that supersedes the given one. The previous revision is never modified, so both prices remain readable and only the newest revision can be priced.

409.description: Not received, already superseded or version conflict.

post.summary: Record a new revision of a supplier quote (If-Match required)

get.summary: Read a stored quote revision snapshot

post.description: A withdrawn quote keeps its data and revision history but can no longer be priced; a reason is required and recorded in the audit trail.

200.description: Withdrawn; the new ETag is returned.

post.summary: Withdraw a received quote (If-Match required)

tags.name: products

tags.description: Trade deals with a validated state machine. Status only changes through POST /deals/{id}/transitions; WON is disabled until sales orders exist.
tags.name: deals

tags.description: Aggregates for the command center, scoped to the active company.
tags.name: dashboard

tags.description: Read-only external-system status. Stage 5A exposes Finance health only; Commerce has no accounting write endpoint.
tags.name: integrations

tags.description: Stage 5C authenticated read-only Finance connector. Every call requires a Commerce session, an active company, company.view and an explicit tenant-scoped Finance company mapping.
tags.name: finance

tags.description: Stage 6 AI Trade Director. Read-only tools over existing services, evidence-cited structured answers, human-approved proposals. It never sends, signs, pays, posts or accepts anything.
